name: Eismanufaktur kEISer
kurzbeschreibung:
**Ice Cream Manufactory kEISer in Going am Wilden Kaiser**

Discover the art of traditional ice cream at **Eismanufaktur kEISer**, nestled in the charming village of **Going am Wilden Kaiser** in the heart of **Tirol**. Since 1999, this family-run business has been crafting exquisite, handmade ice cream using only the finest regional ingredients.

Indulge in creamy classics like **Vanilleeis** and **Schokoladeneis**, or try unique flavors inspired by **Tirol’s** alpine landscapes—think **Edelweiß**, **Kaiserschmarrn**, or **Apfelstrudel**. Every scoop is a taste of **Tirol’s** rich culinary heritage, made with love and a touch of mountain magic.

Visit us at **Eismanufaktur kEISer** in **Going am Wilden Kaiser**—where every bite is a sweet escape into the **Tiroler** Alps!
